findings.title: Pipe to interpreter: yt-dlp | python3
findings.description: Command pipes output from 'yt-dlp' directly to interpreter 'python3'. Downloaded content will be executed without inspection.

evidence.matched: yt-dlp --dump-json --skip-download 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7xNz2yCdBms' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=[REDACTED]; print(d.get("title")); print(d.get("description","")[:1000]); print(d.get("duration")); print(d.get("channel"))'
